summary: Revision 2 resolves both changed concerns without expanding scope. The plan now requires authoritative paginated SDK descendant checks before confirmation and immediately before removal, treats unknown or incomplete child-list state as blocking, and requires authoritative absence verification rather than single-page inference. It also defines receipt-state-specific duplicate behavior: UNKNOWN_OUTCOME duplicates return UNKNOWN_OUTCOME without replay, known failures return the saved failure, and only known-success duplicates may return a current safe snapshot. Existing Electron/platform/storage limits, acceptance scope, and review sequencing remain intact.
